evidence: EXEC SQL absent, EXEC CICS absent

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese Medical Association (JMA) ORCA standard medical receipt (shinryo-hoshu) system — infectious disease survey data creation module
purpose.summary: ORCBINF1 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that creates infectious disease (kansensho) survey data. It reads patient visit history (jyurrk), patient information, diagnoses (byomei), and treatment acts, then evaluates infection-disease judgment tables to produce an output data file and error file for infectious disease reporting.

notable_features: 16 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (CPINFECTION.INC, CPINFJUDGMENT.INC, CPJOBKANRI.INC, etc.)
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM parsed via UNSTRING
MCP (middleware control program) DB access pattern (MCP-TABLE, MCP-PATHNAME, MCP-RC)
OCCURS tables with INDEXED BY for infection and disease judgment
Japanese comments encoded in EUC-JP (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses ORCA MCP abstraction layer
PERFORM UNTIL loop structure for patient-by-patient processing
verdict.notes: Japanese comments are EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1 resulting in mojibake. Program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Source truncated at 16000 chars out of 66547 bytes; full procedure division not visible but structure is clear from what is shown.
